description: Profile a dataset locally (no data leaves the machine): per-column types, cardinality, ranges, measure/dimension roles, temporal/ordinal detection, and cross-column signals (nesting, shared values, association). This is the same measurement engine the BIC Power BI visual uses before generating a chart.

csv_path.description: Path to a CSV file (header row required).

culture.description: The caller's language and region as a BCP 47 tag such as 'de-DE', 'fr' or 'ja-JP'. Default 'en-US'. It is the language the chart's own text is written in (titles, axis labels, legends, notes), and it breaks the tie when a CSV's numbers or dates are ambiguous: 12.500 as twelve thousand five hundred or twelve and a half, 05.03.2024 as 5 March or 3 May. Set it from the end user's locale when you know it; it does not translate the data.

data.description: A pre-typed {columns, rows} table — the shape a Fabric DAX query / dataframe already has. Alternative to csv_path/csv_text; when columns carry isMeasure/format/description the shape matches PBI fidelity with no guessing.

dataType.description: Known type (DAX/semantic-model callers have it); omit to infer from values.

description.description: Column description from the model → modelDesc.

format.description: Format string from the model (e.g. "$#,##0") → modelFormat.

isMeasure.description: Known measure/dimension role; omit to apply the numeric-non-identifier heuristic. A semantic-model caller should set this.

rows.description: Rows as positional arrays aligned to columns, OR objects keyed by column name.

descriptions.description: Per-column human DESCRIPTION — gives the model semantic context the bare column name lacks.

dimensions.description: Columns to treat as DIMENSIONS (a PBI category/axis well — fields to group/break by). Use for numeric codes/years that should NOT be aggregated.

formats.description: Per-column number/date FORMAT STRING (e.g. {"Revenue":"$#,##0","Margin":"0.0%"}). PBI supplies these from its model; a CSV can't, so provide them to steer number formatting.

group_by.description: Columns that are the PRIMARY series/breakdown (the PBI 'Group by' well); the backend leads the visualization with these.

measures.description: Columns to treat as MEASURES (the PBI 'Values' well — fields the chart aggregates). Numeric non-identifier columns are measures by default.

non_additive.description: MEASURE columns that must NOT be summed (a ratio/average/rate — use mean, never stack). Usually auto-detected; this is an authoritative override.

privacy_level.description: How much detail to compute/share: 0 names only, 10 +counts, 20 +detailed stats (default), 30 +obfuscated sample rows.
